title: Adding Part Sales starts Unassigned when the person it copies is switched off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create sales rep A for this test, an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Create staff member D for this test, active at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Create a customer for this test with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to staff member D, and no Part Sales field.
  • Then turn staff member D's "Sales Representative" switch off and save, so Service Parts shows staff member D's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Click the +.
  2. Click "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  3. Save the customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • "Sales Representative - Part Sales" shows last.
  • It reads "Unassigned".
  • Service Parts still reads staff member D's name followed by "(Inactive)".
  • Service Labor still reads sales rep A.

Step 3:

  • The customer saves.
  • Its page lists, in this order: Service Labor with sales rep A, Service Parts with staff member D's name followed by "(Inactive)", and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" with Unassigned.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 13 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned". Under S4-R27 a person whose Sales Representative switch is off or whose account is deactivated is never copied: the added field then starts "Unassigned", and the field they hold keeps them (S4-N2).”
  • S4-R26: “A new part sale starts with the customer's Part Sales field when it is added: the person picked, or "Unassigned" when "Unassigned" was picked. Without a Part Sales field it starts with the Service Parts person, or the one representative when the customer is not split.”
  • S4-R27: “Only a staff member whose account is active and whose Sales Representative switch is on is copied (S1-R8). Anyone else leaves that field "Unassigned", and S4-R17 and S4-R18 still apply at invoicing.”
  • S4-N2: “Turning off a staff member's Sales Representative switch, without deactivating their account, leaves them in the customer fields they hold, as today. In Edit Customer and on the customer page their name reads followed by "(Inactive)", for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)", as on the work order (S1-E2). They are not offered in the dropdown, so no option is checked while they hold the field.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026; answer 41, 23 Oct 2026), read 23 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 41: “41. (b) "Unassigned", and the same for an added "Sales Representative - Service Parts" field. A new field never starts with a person whose Sales Representative switch is off or whose account is deactivated (S4-R27). The field they already hold keeps them, reading for example "Elliot Brennan (Inactive)" (S4-N2). PRD v13, S4-R7 and S4-R8.”
